policy.rule: Choose the shortest complete eligible current-contract algorithm. Preserve all meaning and fields; keep current primary on a tie.
policy.fairness: Same observable task, API/effects and helper accounting boundary; architectural mechanisms need not imitate each other.
policy.single_core: There is one current LMX core. Historical int-specialized helper source is explanation, not another loadable library version or a valid competitor for a generic contract.
policy.includes: Whole primary listing including required declarations and throws. Core LMX operations do not need imports. Shared core implementation is separately counted.
